gen-dafont-bloody-gf-alexandria: Big round lowercase bowls give Bloody its commanding, bloody-minded presence right away. And Alexandria, a sans with a tall body and terminals flung wide, gives the heading somewhere to rest.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-amiko: Amiko keeps a modern, tall lowercase with terminals that flare outward like tongs. Amiko handles the quiet, steady reading, while Bloody does the shouting with its big round bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-bangla: Friendly and contemporary, with wide s curves that barely curl in and a short climb to the ascenders. Anek Bangla gives that ease to the page while Bloody keeps a commanding grip with its round bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-devanagari: Bloody pushes its lowercase into big round bowls, loud and commanding from the first glance. And Anek Devanagari, sans-serif with distinctly open mouths and a tall middle zone, is what makes the pair easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-gujarati: Loud and commanding, Bloody drops big round bowls into the heading, while Anek Gujarati keeps lowercase that rivals its capitals. Its gaping c opening gives the heading room to roar.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-kannada: Tall and squared-off like woodblock type, this sans keeps its terminals well away from the stems. Anek Kannada feels crisp and current beside Bloody, whose big round bowls carry a loud, commanding streak.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-latin: Bloody comes in commanding, with big round lowercase bowls that look ready for a fight. Anek Latin keeps its letters held open and its lowercase near capital height, so it can stay modest beneath the heading.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-malayalam: Big round lowercase bowls make Bloody look commanding, even bloody, at first sight. And Anek Malayalam does the quieter work, its caps close to lowercase height and curve tips that never touch.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-odia: Commanding from the first glance, Bloody rounds its lowercase into big bowls. Anek Odia is a sans-serif with unsealed rounds and capitals barely above lowercase, so shrinking Bloody would waste its bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil shares big round lowercase bowls with the heading, its c and s looking half unwrapped. Anek Tamil softens what Bloody shouts, so the sans-serif echoes its roundness without copying the menace.
